inclusion.rule: A card exists for every public repository owned by fschmutz that is not a fork, not archived, and has something a visitor can actually use: a GitHub Pages site, a downloadable artefact, or a single self-contained file. Forks are never listed, however much they are used, because the work is someone else's. A repository that only supports another card — a Homebrew tap, a release channel — is folded into that card instead of getting one of its own. tools/check.py enforces the Pages half of this rule and reads the omissions list below for the rest.

omissions.reason: This site. It is the page, not an item on it.
Install channel for claude-usage-panel, not a project. Folded into that card as the brew line.
Fork of OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator with no commits of its own. Not Falco's work, so the no-forks rule applies even though it is useful.
